APPROVE

The loop body moved into `NestControllerRoutes` with the same logic, the nested ternary became `NestDecision` with `classGuard || UseGuards` folded into `methodGuard`, and the body-span computation was extracted unchanged, so behaviour is preserved and each remaining method looks well under 15. I couldn't compile it, and the diff doesn't show the type of `classDecorators`, so the `List<Decorator>` parameter is the one build risk I can't rule out.
